headline: Argentina Faces Technical Recession as Inflation Exceeds 31% Mark
summary: Economic activity indicators in Argentina indicate a potential technical recession, with annual inflation staying above 31.3% for 15 consecutive months and 85% of sectors stagnating.
why: Argentina is South America's third-largest economy, currently undergoing major macroeconomic adjustment under economic reform programs.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Persistent inflation combined with contracting industrial activity weakens economic recovery prospects.
